name: UK energy price cap
summary: Forecasters see the January energy cap rising about 26–27%, above the 20% Alert line
state: The Ofgem cap for October to December is £1,723 a year for a typical dual-fuel household. Uswitch's average of supplier forecasts (30 Oct) points to a 27% rise in January 2027, and other forecasts put the increase at about £442 a year, both above the 20% Alert line, driven by the wholesale gas surge. Ofgem announces the January cap by 25 Nov.
for_you: Household energy bills are likely to rise sharply from 1 January. Ofgem and Citizens Advice publish guidance on support if you're struggling to pay.

sources.title: Uswitch — Energy price cap January 2027: latest predictions

why: The Ofgem cap sets bills for most UK households — a direct cost-of-living signal.
drivers: Wholesale gas and power prices, network costs, policy levies.
